title: Petition of MetroBus, Inc. pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 5 for a 120-day temporary license to authorize the operation of motor vehicles to be used in the restricted common carriage of passengers for hire, pursuant to an agreement with Medical Area Service Corporation in the Cities of Boston and Cambridge, the Town of Brookline and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority and the Metropolitan District Commission.
